title: Regularity Preservation for Jump-Type Stochastic Transport Equations with Singular Drift
summary: We study a first-order stochastic transport equation driven by Brownian transport noise and a nonlinear state-dependent Poisson jump term. The drift vector field is merely integrable and satisfies the subcritical Krylov--Röckner condition. The dependence of the jump coefficient on the solution creates a nontrivial coupling between the solution value and its spatial gradient. To handle this coupling, we construct a stochastic characteristic system for the position, the solution value, and the gradient, and derive a characteristic representation by means of an Itô--Wentzell formula with jumps.…
